title: Full C5 fused loop: rank scaling, conformal K, OR-LSH admission, CASM-K execution, verifier, and closed-loop learning
question: Can a dense outcome-trained CDL Q/K shortlister support calibrated bounded-K admission so exact CASM execution and verification decouple final correctness from M?
hypothesis: The exhaustive target-rank distribution grows sublinearly with population M on the registered state-addressing workload.
Split-conformal calibration yields a held-out K(M,alpha) with empirical coverage near the requested level.
OR-over-tables random-hyperplane admission can retain the target with materially fewer reranked candidates than M when p1 is high and p2 is near 0.5.
Exact CASM execution plus a post-execution verifier makes conditional selection accuracy substantially higher than raw CDL Top-1 precision.
Verified candidates written to the experience namespace improve subsequent routing without contaminating world state.
held_constant: dim=16, exact equality relation over all bits
fresh target code each training step
candidate action/index never enters routing features
verifier receives no hidden target index
gates: CASM exhaustive verifier success must be exactly one candidate per valid trial
No router input may contain target_index or acceptable_actions
Target codes must be unique within each population
Persistent world writes become visible only after a one-step temporal boundary
capability_rule: Do not claim sublinear addressing unless measured routing work exponent is <1 and no table cap binds. Do not claim high absolute capability from retention alone.
coverage_rule: Report calibrated K and empirical held-out coverage separately; conformal guarantee is conditional on exchangeability.
execution_rule: CASM execution count must equal the number of admitted candidates and be bounded by calibrated K.
non_claims: synthetic equality state-addressing does not establish language-level semantic retrieval
arithmetic MACs are not hardware wall-clock speedups
index build cost is reported separately from query cost
online learning results are descriptive unless preregistered causal interventions isolate the update
shortlist_policy: K is obtained from held-out exhaustive target-rank calibration; no beam sweep is used to choose K
